name: FauxLite
author: GraphicHealer
description: Show FPP now-playing info and custom messages on a Pro-Lite LED sign through a FauxLite WiFi-to-serial bridge.

privacy.summary: Sends message text and 'now playing' song info to the FauxLite LED-sign controller you configure, so it can show them on a Pro-Lite display.

sends.to: the FauxLite device at the local address you configure
sends.what: message text, page/style commands, now-playing song title/artist/filename
sends.why: to display it on the LED sign

privacy.other: All traffic is plain HTTP on your LAN to the single device address you enter. Nothing is sent until the device address is set and the plugin is enabled (or a FPP command is used); now-playing updates only run while that option is on. No credentials are used and nothing leaves your network.
